detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Gonadorelin

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C₅₅H₇₅N₁₇O₁₃
  • Molecular Weight: ~1182.3 g/mol
  • Sequence: pyroGlu-His-Trp-Ser-Tyr-Gly-Leu-Arg-Pro-Gly-NH₂
  • Peptide Length: Decapeptide
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Gonadorelin is a synthetic decapeptide corresponding to the naturally occurring gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) peptide sequence. It is produced via solid-phase peptide synthesis and supplied as a lyophilized powder for laboratory use.

Supplied as a lyophilized powder, Gonadorelin is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro laboratory research applications conducted by qualified professionals and is not formulated for clinical, diagnostic, or therapeutic use.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro studies of peptide–receptor binding dynamics
  • Laboratory investigation of synthetic peptide analogs in controlled cell-based assay systems
  • Comparative structural analysis of short regulatory peptide sequences
  • Analytical method development involving decapeptide compounds
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Handle using appropriate aseptic laboratory techniques to maintain product integrity
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in common laboratory solvents
Compliance Notice:

Gonadorelin is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
